input:
# This is the database URL, make sure it's correct
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost:5432/myapp
# Secret key for JWT stuff
JWT_SECRET=super-secret-key

# The application will be built using the Node.js image
FROM node:18
# Dependencies should be installed before copying the source code
RUN npm install

# This job does the testing stuff
# It runs all the tests and makes sure nothing is broken
# If something fails, the build will be marked as red
test:
  script: npm test
